Ashley Noffke leaves Pakistan cricket role for Netherlands coaching job

Ashley Noffke has departed his role as bowling coach for the Pakistan cricket team to take over as head coach for the Netherlands men's team. Noffke's contract with Pakistan was set to run until June 2027, but he will leave after the Asian Games 2026. He has signed a two-year contract with the Netherlands. This departure follows other coaching staff leaving the Pakistan team.
